summary: Gives students a single home page listing every enrolled course, upcoming deadlines, and recent instructor announcements.
Lets students upload assignment files before a deadline and gives instructors a single view of every submission for a given assignment.
Keeps grades entered in the instructor gradebook synced to the student-facing transcript view within minutes of being posted.
Hosts threaded discussion forums for each course, letting instructors require a minimum number of posts as part of participation grading.
A lightweight mobile app for checking grades, submitting quick assignments, and getting push notifications for new announcements.
Lets instructors build quizzes from a mix of multiple choice, short answer, and essay questions, with randomized ordering per student.
Automatically grades objective quiz questions on submission and queues open-ended answers for an instructor's manual review.
Lets instructors score essays and projects against a shared rubric, giving students a breakdown of how points were earned on each criterion.
Monitors a remote exam session for irregular activity, flagging moments for a proctor to review rather than blocking the exam outright.
Stores a shared library of reusable exam questions tagged by topic and difficulty, so instructors can build new assessments faster.
Gives student project groups a shared workspace to co-edit documents and track task assignments for a group assignment.
Lets an instructor and students draw and annotate together on a shared digital whiteboard during a live class session.
Splits a virtual class into smaller discussion groups for a set time and automatically returns everyone to the main session when time is up.
Randomly assigns students to review a set number of classmates' submissions against a rubric before the instructor finalizes grades.
Lets an instructor launch a quick poll or knowledge-check during a live lecture and see aggregated responses on screen in real time.
Lets prospective students fill out and submit an application, upload transcripts, and track their application status in one place.
Shows applicants a live checklist of which required documents have been received and which are still outstanding.
Coordinates admissions interview slots between applicants and alumni interviewers, sending reminders ahead of the scheduled time.
Releases admission decisions to applicants at a scheduled time and generates the accompanying decision letter automatically.
Tracks waitlisted applicants and lets admissions officers extend offers as enrolled seats open up, respecting the ranked waitlist order.
Imports a student's FAFSA data directly into the financial aid system, reducing manual re-entry errors when calculating an aid package.
Generates a student's personalized financial aid award letter, breaking down grants, loans, and work-study offers by source.
Matches students to scholarships they're eligible for based on major, GPA, and background, and tracks which ones they've applied to.
Tracks the disbursement schedule of a student's aid package against tuition due dates so refunds and holds are calculated correctly.
Lets a student submit a financial aid appeal with supporting documents and routes it to a review committee for a decision.
Lets academic departments create and publish new course listings with descriptions, credit hours, and learning outcomes.
Checks a student's completed coursework against a course's prerequisites during registration and blocks enrollment if they're not met.
Helps department schedulers assign course sections to rooms and time slots without creating instructor or room double-bookings.
Shows students real-time open seat counts for each course section during registration, including live waitlist position.
Archives every course syllabus by term, giving advisors and accreditation reviewers a searchable historical record.
Lets instructors take attendance from a phone or tablet at the start of class, with students able to self check-in via a QR code.
Notifies an advisor when a student crosses an absence threshold in any course, prompting early outreach before it affects their grade.
Automatically informs students when their regular instructor is out and a substitute will be teaching that day's session.
Gives K-12 administrators a school-wide view of chronic absenteeism trends broken down by grade level and homeroom.
Sends parents a same-day text or email when their child is marked absent or tardy, with an option to submit an excuse note in reply.
Lets students browse available tutors by subject and book a session directly into the tutor's open calendar slots.
Lets tutors log a summary of what was covered after each session, visible to the student and their academic advisor.
Matches students needing help in a course with peer tutors who previously earned a top grade in it, based on schedule overlap.
Tracks a tutee's grade trend across sessions so tutoring center staff can see which students are improving and which need a new approach.
Manages a virtual line for the walk-in tutoring center, notifying students when a tutor is ready so they don't have to wait in person.
Maps each lesson plan to the state or national standards it addresses, helping curriculum leads spot gaps in coverage before the term ends.
Lets teachers build multi-week instructional units with linked lesson plans, assessments, and pacing notes in one document.
Shows teachers whether their class is ahead of or behind the district's recommended pacing guide for the current unit.
Hosts a shared library of approved worksheets, slide decks, and activities that teachers can attach directly to their lesson plans.
Routes new or revised curriculum materials through department and instructional-coach review before they're approved for classroom use.
Adds structured navigation landmarks to course content so screen reader users can jump directly to assignments, grades, or announcements.
Automatically generates captions for lecture recordings and flags low-confidence segments for an instructor to double-check.
Suggests descriptive alt text for images uploaded into course materials, which instructors can accept or edit before publishing.
Rewrites a reading passage at a lower or higher lexile level on request, giving teachers differentiated versions of the same material.
Tracks each student's approved accommodations, like extended time, and flags instructors when an assessment doesn't yet honor them.
Lets alumni search and connect with classmates by graduating class, major, or industry, opting in to how much of their profile is visible.
Lets alumni make a one-time or recurring donation to a specific fund and see a running total of the campaign's progress.
Manages RSVPs and check-in for alumni reunions and regional chapter events, syncing attendee counts back to the events team.
Pairs current students with alumni mentors in a similar field, based on shared interests and availability for regular check-ins.
Lets the alumni office assemble and send a segmented newsletter to graduates by class year, region, or degree program.
Lets staff and student organizations reserve classrooms and meeting spaces, checking availability against the official campus room schedule.
Lets faculty and staff submit a facilities work order, like a broken projector, and tracks it through assignment and completion.
Registers campus visitors at the front desk, printing a visitor badge and notifying the host of their arrival.
Issues and deactivates student and staff ID cards, syncing access permissions to dorms, labs, and libraries as enrollment status changes.
Sends immediate text, email, and app alerts to everyone on campus during a safety incident, with a follow-up all-clear message.
